decisions.reason: Changing the letter's date format does not alter the requirement to apply the PE stamp and signature.
The date-format correction affects the concurrence document presentation, not the scope, basis, or purpose of the electrical modification review.
The specific date correction is handled by the source documentation-format Requirement and does not change the standing obligation to incorporate bounded client or city comments.
The letter date format for the current concurrence package is unrelated to calculations for the separate additional permit project.
The date-format correction does not affect the deferred deliverable for the separate additional permit project.
